The ground stabilizes, and a single light pulses — the Time-Sync Core Fragment activates, and the player gains a new ability: 'Time Anchor' — the ability to freeze time for 3 seconds around themselves, but only after using the Twin-Second Beacon in battle. This ability is not required for victory, but it is a reward for mastery of the timeline.

boss.name: Malachor the Frozen
boss.victory_condition: Player must use the Twin-Second Pulse Beacon at the exact moment the boss initiates its first time loop to break it. Once the loop is broken, the boss is vulnerable and can be defeated with regular attacks. If the Beacon is not used correctly, the loop repeats and the boss regains 20 health per loop. After five failed attempts, the boss becomes immune to all attacks and the level ends in failure.

level.objective: Restore the central time-stem by defeating all enemies and activating the Time-Sync Core Fragment. The level ends only when the core glows blue and the clocks begin to tick in sync.
level.reward: Time-Sync Core Fragment — unlocks 'Time Anchor' passive ability and increases chronal energy regeneration by 20% for the player’s next level. Also unlocks a new mechanic: 'Chrono-Loop Mastery' that allows the player to reset the battlefield state after a defeat via a timed reset (after 30 seconds).

level.setting: The Hollow Gears of Veridian Spire
level.player_weapon: Cog-Wraith Siphon (a brass-ringed, pulsating device that drains mechanical energy from the environment)

enemy.name: Gutter Ghoul
enemy.weakness: The Gutter Ghoul is vulnerable to the Cog-Wraith Siphon's pulsing frequency. When the player uses the Siphon to drain ambient mechanical energy, it causes the Ghoul's joints to freeze, reducing its damage output by 50% and increasing its vulnerability to follow-up attacks by 30%.

encounters.hazard: Rotating brass gears drip oily residue that slows movement. The player must move slowly and avoid stepping on the oily platforms.

pickup.name: Screwing Coil (a salvaged, creaking coil of insulated copper wire)
pickup.effect: After using the Screwed Coil, the player can temporarily boost their weapon's power by 15% for 30 seconds. This effect is triggered only if the player successfully defeats the Gutter Ghoul with a full charge of the Cog-Wraith Siphon.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Gutter Ghoul, the floor trembles and a gear-laden door slowly opens at the back of the chamber. Inside, a faint mechanical whisper echoes — a warning of the next chamber. The Screwing Coil is found embedded in a crumbling gear base. If the player fails to retrieve it, the door seals and the Ghoul spawns again in a loop (a brutal difficulty trigger).

enemy.name: Soot Warden
enemy.weakness: The Soot Warden is vulnerable to the Screwing Coil’s electromagnetic pulse. When activated, the Coil causes a temporary surge of current through the Warden’s soot-covered body, freezing its limbs and reducing its attack speed by 70% for 5 seconds. The player can activate the Coil only once per encounter.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with thick, smoke that reduces visibility. The player must navigate using a flickering brass compass that only works when the player is within 5 meters of a gear source.

pickup.name: Pulse Regulator (a brass and copper device that stores mechanical pulses)
pickup.effect: After defeating the Soot Warden, the Pulse Regulator activates. If the player uses it during the next encounter, it grants a 10% damage boost to the Cog-Wraith Siphon and increases its drain rate by 25%. This effect cannot be used more than once per session.

encounters.trigger: The Warden’s final move is a spinning soot vortex that pulls nearby gear fragments into a trap. If the player fails to activate the Screwing Coil before the vortex completes, the Warden triggers a self-replication sequence, spawning a second Warden with 20% more health. If not defeated, the player enters a 30-second mechanical collapse — a loop that resets the encounter, and increases the difficulty by 20% per failure.

enemy.name: The Gearmaw Spire
enemy.weakness: The Gearmaw Spire is vulnerable only to the Pulse Regulator when activated at the exact moment the Spire opens its central cogs. When the Pulse Regulator is used during the final assault, it triggers a harmonic resonance that shatters the Spire’s core, causing a 50% reduction in damage and a 100% chance of stunning the creature for 3 seconds. The Pulse Regulator must be used within 4 seconds of the Spire’s first gear-rotation sound — otherwise, it fails and the Spire enters a frenzy mode.

encounters.hazard: The ground is unstable and emits low-frequency vibrations. Every 15 seconds, the floor shifts, and the player takes 10 damage. The player must time their movements with the pulsing frequency of the Spire.

pickup.name: The Resonant Core (a glowing, fractured gear found at the chamber’s center)
pickup.effect: If the player acquires this pickup during the final fight, it grants immunity to the Spire’s crushing gravity pulse and allows the Cog-Wraith Siphon to drain energy at double speed. However, using it requires sacrificing all remaining health — a risk that only a geomancer with deep mechanical intuition can take.

encounters.trigger: The chamber door opens to reveal a massive, mechanical titan made of fused gears and rusted pistons. The Gearmaw Spire begins rotating its core. If the player fails to use the Pulse Regulator within the 4-second window, the Spire unleashes a chain-reaction explosion that damages all nearby gear and causes 30% of the player's health to be drained instantly. The player must use the Resonant Core to survive — otherwise, the encounter resets and the player must retry the entire sequence with increased difficulty.

boss.name: The Gearmaw Spire (Elder Form)
boss.weakness: The Spire is vulnerable only to the Pulse Regulator *activated immediately after the Resonant Core is found*. The Resonant Core must be used before the Spire's first core rotation. If not used, the Spire activates a self-sustaining feedback loop that drains the player’s energy and increases its health by 10% every 10 seconds. Only one use of the Pulse Regulator is available during the fight — and it must be used at the exact moment the Core begins to pulse.
boss.victory_condition: The player must defeat the Spire with a full use of the Pulse Regulator within 30 seconds of the Core's activation, or the fight ends in failure and the level resets.

level.objective: Reach the Core Chasm and destroy the Gearmaw Spire by exploiting the mechanics of prior pickups and the player’s Cog-Wraith Siphon. Each encounter is a trial of precision, timing, and risk — and failure means suffering repeated, brutal trials.
level.reward: The player gains access to the Geomantic Archives, a hidden library containing forbidden equations that allow the creation of a self-sustaining, living engine — a weapon more powerful than the Cog-Wraith Siphon, but one that may awaken the spire’s dormant heart in the future.

level.setting: Coghaven Garden – a peaceful, clockwork-embellished city park where brass trees, steam canals, and floating gears form gentle spirals. Sunlight filters through brass arches, and quiet chimes echo as steam dances in the air. The ground is paved with polished copper tiles, and small clockwork flowers bloom in rhythmic patterns. A central fountain pulses with soft light, guarded by ancient machinery.

enemy.name: Gearsprite (Minor Dissonance)
enemy.weakness: Holy Hammer (Player's primary weapon – causes a 'Harmonic Resonance' effect that shatters its gears).

encounters.hazard: None – a gentle breeze moves the gears in a rhythmic pattern.

pickup.name: Steam Resonance Crystal
pickup.effect: When equipped, the player’s Holy Hammer emits a soft golden hum. This crystal is essential for the boss fight and will trigger a resonance effect when used on the boss. Can be used to slow time in the garden for 3 seconds (a minor ability).

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Gearsprite, the crystal glows and emits a soft chime. A small gear path appears, leading toward the Whispering Gear-Weaver’s workshop. The player sees a faint, rustling noise from a clockwork shed.

enemy.name: Whispering Gear-Weaver
enemy.weakness: Holy Mace (a weapon formed when the player uses the Steam Resonance Crystal on their Holy Hammer. The crystal transforms it temporarily into a mace with a 'Gearspring' effect). The enemy's gears stutter when struck by a mace.

encounters.hazard: The shed creaks with every movement. A low-frequency hum builds as the enemy speaks in riddles.

pickup.name: Gearspring Compass
pickup.effect: Detects enemy presence within 15 meters. Shows a red dot on the screen when an enemy is near. Helps the player anticipate the next encounter. Can be used to locate the central fountain (boss area).

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Whispering Gear-Weaver, the compass activates. It shows a red dot glowing steadily toward the central fountain. A large clockwork gear slowly rotates in the distance – the Grand Chrono-Sentinel begins to hum.

enemy.name: Grand Chrono-Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Steam Resonance Crystal (must be used during the fight. When the crystal is activated, it causes the sentinel’s core to overheat and stop for 4 seconds, resetting its rhythm. This can be repeated for 3 times).

encounters.hazard: The fountain pulses with light every 5 seconds. The sentinel’s gears turn slowly, as if in deep thought.

pickup.name: Time-Still Orb
pickup.effect: Fused with the Steam Resonance Crystal to create a permanent harmonic bond. Gives paladin a passive ability: 'Steady Shield' which reduces incoming damage by 20% when the crystal is active.

encounters.trigger: The Compass shows the red dot locked on the fountain. The sentinel’s gears begin to spin faster and emit a warning chime. The player is drawn toward it by the hum. The crystal must be used in combat to trigger its weakness.

boss.name: Grand Chrono-Sentinel
boss.weakness: Steam Resonance Crystal (specific pickup from Encounter 1)
boss.victory_condition: The player must use the Steam Resonance Crystal at least twice during the fight to stop the sentinel's rhythm. Once the third use occurs, the core fractures and the boss collapses, ending the level with a calm chime and a golden bloom of clockwork flowers.

level.objective: Restore harmony to the garden by defeating the three mechanical guardians. The journey is peaceful, with each enemy a small disruption to balance. The player learns to trust their weapon, gather tools, and understand how the world operates through harmony and resonance.
level.reward: A new passive ability – 'Harmonic Shield' – that reduces incoming damage by 10% when the Steam Resonance Crystal is equipped. Also gains access to the 'Coghaven Archives' for future quests.
